13800#[cfg(test)]
13801mod backend_refusal_tests {
13802    use reverie::Pid;
13803    use reverie::Tool;
13804
13805    use super::*;
13806    use crate::config::Config;
13807    use crate::record_or_replay::NoopTool;
13808    use crate::syscall_hot_path_tests::InjectGuest;
13809
13810    const DIAGNOSTIC: &str = "this backend does not implement the call";
13811
13812    /// A fail-closed tool whose policy returns the typed error rather than
13813    /// ending the process, and a guest whose last injection the backend
13814    /// refused with `refusal`.
13815    fn fail_closed(
13816        refusal: Option<reverie::UnsupportedRefusal>,
13817    ) -> (Detcore<NoopTool>, InjectGuest<NoopTool>) {
13818        let config = Config {
13819            panic_on_unsupported_syscalls: true,
13820            exit_on_unsupported_syscall: true,
13821            shutdown_on_unsupported_syscall: false,
13822            ..Config::default()
13823        };
13824        let tool = <Detcore<NoopTool> as Tool>::new(Pid::from_raw(4242), &config);
13825        let mut guest = InjectGuest::<NoopTool>::new(Ok(0));
13826        guest.config = config;
13827        if let Some(refusal) = refusal {
13828            guest = guest.with_refusal(refusal);
13829        }
13830        (tool, guest)
13831    }
13832
13833    fn refusal(operation: reverie::UnsupportedOperation) -> reverie::UnsupportedRefusal {
13834        reverie::UnsupportedRefusal::new(operation, Errno::ENOSYS, DIAGNOSTIC)
13835    }
13836
13837    const CALLS: [(Sysno, reverie::UnsupportedOperation); 4] = [
13838        (
13839            Sysno::pkey_alloc,
13840            reverie::UnsupportedOperation::ProtectionKeys,
13841        ),
13842        (
13843            Sysno::pkey_mprotect,
13844            reverie::UnsupportedOperation::ProtectionKeys,
13845        ),
13846        (
13847            Sysno::pkey_free,
13848            reverie::UnsupportedOperation::ProtectionKeys,
13849        ),
13850        (
13851            Sysno::userfaultfd,
13852            reverie::UnsupportedOperation::Userfaultfd,
13853        ),
13854    ];
13855
13856    /// The backend's refusal of the call is refused by policy under the
13857    /// call's name, fail-closed: the guest never sees the backend's ENOSYS,
13858    /// and the call counts as refused.
13859    #[test]
13860    fn the_calls_own_refusal_is_refused_by_policy() {
13861        futures::executor::block_on(async {
13862            for (sysno, operation) in CALLS {
13863                let (tool, mut guest) = fail_closed(Some(refusal(operation)));
13864                let result = tool
13865                    .report_backend_refusal(&mut guest, sysno, operation, Err(Errno::ENOSYS.into()))
13866                    .await;
13867                match result {
13868                    Err(Error::Tool(error)) => assert_eq!(
13869                        error
13870                            .downcast_ref::<crate::UnsupportedSyscallError>()
13871                            .expect("the policy's named refusal")
13872                            .0,
13873                        sysno
13874                    ),
13875                    other => panic!("{sysno}: expected the typed refusal, got {other:?}"),
13876                }
13877                assert!(guest.thread_state().stats.syscall_refused, "{sysno}");
13878                assert!(
13879                    guest.injected().is_empty(),
13880                    "{sysno}: nothing more is injected"
13881                );
13882            }
13883        })
13884    }
13885
13886    /// Anything else keeps the call's own result: a success (the refusal is
13887    /// left for the event's end), an errno the backend did not explain, and a
13888    /// refusal of another operation or with another errno than the call's.
13889    #[test]
13890    fn anything_else_keeps_the_calls_result() {
13891        futures::executor::block_on(async {
13892            for (sysno, operation) in CALLS {
13893                let (tool, mut guest) = fail_closed(Some(refusal(operation)));
13894                let result = tool
13895                    .report_backend_refusal(&mut guest, sysno, operation, Ok(3))
13896                    .await;
13897                assert!(matches!(result, Ok(3)), "{sysno}: {result:?}");
13898                assert!(
13899                    guest.take_unsupported_refusal().is_some(),
13900                    "{sysno}: a success leaves the refusal in place"
13901                );
13902
13903                let (tool, mut guest) = fail_closed(None);
13904                let result = tool
13905                    .report_backend_refusal(&mut guest, sysno, operation, Err(Errno::ENOSYS.into()))
13906                    .await;
13907                assert!(
13908                    matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ENOSYS))),
13909                    "{sysno}: {result:?}"
13910                );
13911                assert!(!guest.thread_state().stats.syscall_refused, "{sysno}");
13912
13913                let other = if operation == reverie::UnsupportedOperation::Userfaultfd {
13914                    reverie::UnsupportedOperation::ProtectionKeys
13915                } else {
13916                    reverie::UnsupportedOperation::Userfaultfd
13917                };
13918                for (backend, errno) in [
13919                    (refusal(other), Errno::ENOSYS),
13920                    (
13921                        reverie::UnsupportedRefusal::new(operation, Errno::EINVAL, DIAGNOSTIC),
13922                        Errno::ENOSYS,
13923                    ),
13924                ] {
13925                    let (tool, mut guest) = fail_closed(Some(backend));
13926                    let result = tool
13927                        .report_backend_refusal(&mut guest, sysno, operation, Err(errno.into()))
13928                        .await;
13929                    assert!(
13930                        matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ENOSYS))),
13931                        "{sysno}: {result:?}"
13932                    );
13933                    // Judged as the event's last refusal: counted, not answered.
13934                    assert!(guest.thread_state().stats.syscall_refused, "{sysno}");
13935                }
13936            }
13937        })
13938    }
13939}
13940
13941#[cfg(test)]
13942mod turn_decision_tests {
13943    use super::turn_decides_interruption;
13944    use crate::config::Config;
13945
13946    /// A poller decides interruption at its turn only where the pending sets
13947    /// it reads are the kernel's (ptrace). KVM keeps the discarded-at-send
13948    /// record since SIGSHARE S3b, but its shared queue goes to the thread the
13949    /// tool reserves a permit for, so the backend's polled-read observation
13950    /// keeps deciding there; otherwise the first poller after a POSIX timer's
13951    /// expiry takes the SIGUSR1 Linux leaves to a `sigtimedwait` waiter
13952    /// (revastra2 delta F3, `posix-sigwait`).
13953    #[test]
13954    fn only_a_backend_whose_kernel_state_is_the_guests_decides_at_the_turn() {
13955        for (name, backend, sequentialize_threads, expected) in [
13956            ("ptrace", reverie::BackendCapabilities::PTRACE, true, true),
13957            (
13958                "ptrace unsequentialized",
13959                reverie::BackendCapabilities::PTRACE,
13960                false,
13961                false,
13962            ),
13963            ("kvm", reverie::BackendCapabilities::KVM, true, false),
13964        ] {
13965            let cfg = Config {
13966                sequentialize_threads,
13967                ..Config::default().with_backend(|b| *b = backend)
13968            };
13969            if name == "kvm" {
13970                assert!(
13971                    crate::scheduler::discarded_at_send::records(&cfg),
13972                    "KVM keeps the record since S3b"
13973                );
13974            }
13975            assert_eq!(turn_decides_interruption(&cfg), expected, "{name}");
13976        }
13977    }
13978}
